results.title: Peanut Butter
results.overview: Little girl asks uncooperative fireman for help rescuing her beloved pet.

results.title: The Deceased
results.overview: When their father dies on a cursed day, terror follows siblings Nuri and Yanda as they navigate myths, rituals and their older brother's protests.

results.title: Going Places
results.overview: After covering up a hit and run on the way to their valedictory desert getaway, three high school graduates face the true test of their friendship when they become entangled in a deadly crime ring imbroglio.

results.title: Leibniz – Chronicle of a Lost Painting
results.overview: Out of her love for the great thinker Leibniz, Queen Charlotte commissions a portrait of him. During the portrait sessions, the philosopher and the young painter engage in a passionate struggle for truth in image and likeness, and ultimately for love and death.

results.title: In the Musical Intimacy of a Film Score
results.original_title: Dans l'intimité musicale d'une partition de cinéma
results.overview: It is the story of a love affair between a musical score and a screenplay! Chief editor Bernard Sasia observes and interviews the key figures of this journey. Centered on the collaboration between composer Michel Petrossian and director Robert Guédiguian, Sasia uses his editing tools to capture the sudden emergence of a musical creation for the cinema.

results.title: The Inverted Case
results.overview: The brutal murder of 17 year old Hailey Easton shakes a small community to its core, sparking an investigation by local law enforcement. Detectives Trevino and Bellamy find themselves in a labyrinth of perplexing clues and suspects.

results.title: Dragon Seduction
results.overview: After breaking free from a millennium-long imprisonment, the Black Dragon Ye Ying escaped, seized the Golden Dragon's magic power and gravely wounded the old Dragon King. The new Dragon King Fu Xi ventured into the Demon Market to seek the legendary Demon-Subduing Sword in a bid to reclaim the Golden Dragon's magic power. However, he fell into a cunning trap where the sacred sword was briefly recovered only to be lost again. Ultimately, Fu Xi tapped into his latent potential and reclaimed the old Dragon King's Golden Dragon magic power.

results.title: The Final Party
results.overview: As graduation nears, scholarship students at a party face a night of terror when the wealthy elite crash in, acting on dark childhood traumas. Trapped, they must survive the chaos and violence until dawn.

results.title: There's No Freaking Way I'll Be Your Lover! Unless… ~Next Shine~
results.original_title: わたしが恋人になれるわけないじゃん、ムリムリ!（※ムリじゃなかった!?）～ネクストシャイン！～
results.overview: Renako Amaori, a former gloomy and socially awkward girl, reinvented herself for high school and successfully made her debut. She even managed to join the top- tier popular group... only to be suddenly confessed to by two of its brightest stars?! While still struggling to give them an answer, Renako agrees to help her friend Kaho by joining a cosplay event. It's the perfect excuse to delay her reply... or so she thought. But as she witnesses Kaho's passion firsthand, something begins to stir inside her.

results.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Special Edition Swordsmith Village Arc Part 1
results.original_title: 鬼滅の刃 刀鍛冶の里 敵襲編
results.overview: A recap of Kimetsu no Yaiba episodes 45–49, Tanjiro's journey leads him to the Swordsmith Village, where he reunites with two Hashira, members of the Demon Slayer Corps' highest-ranking - Mist Hashira Muichiro Tokito and Love Hashira Mitsuri Kanroji. With the shadows of demons lurking near, a new battle begins for Tanjiro and his comrades.

results.title: Ophelia
results.overview: In the wake of her best friend's untimely death, Robin receives an unexpected gift: her late friend's pet mouse. As she grapples with grief and guilt, Robin is led on a journey of healing, acceptance, and the enduring bonds of friendship.

results.title: The Pearl Comb
results.overview: In 1893 Cornwall, a doctor is sent to investigate a miraculous claim that a fisherman's wife has cured tuberculosis, but what he discovers is more than he can believe.

results.title: Out of the Woods
results.overview: Max reconnects with Diana, an old friend, stirring long-forgotten emotions. Her fading memory complicates matters as she grapples with her deep love for Diana and her commitment to her husband, Charlie.

results.title: Laurika se Tuiskoms
results.overview: A documentary about Laurika Rauch's exceptional contribution to the Afrikaans musical landscape. Laurika se Tuiskoms was produced specially now that she has finally said goodbye to the stage, but seen as a retrospective of her career, it is indeed where she has been at home for the past 50 years.

results.title: You Gotta Have Faith
results.overview: After twenty years running a parish with more debt than parishioners, Father Steve ends up officiating the wedding of his high school sweetheart, Isabel. But when the groom bolts, Isabel is left homeless – and Steve takes her in, with one catch: only nuns are allowed to live in the church. What starts as a holy disguise soon stirs up old feelings, and Steve must choose between his vows to God… and his heart.

results.title: Zhaza
results.overview: In a small town, a corrupt major learns that his daughter has been raped by the chief of police. He takes him hostage and fights off the rape squads, while trying to save his daughter and establish a relationship with her.

results.title: Lūgnė
results.overview: Teenage girl's reality begins to shatter after her younger sister disappears and long forgotten truth begins to reveal itself
